Sandbox_SZedPlus_SpawnRate_tooltip: How many ordinary zombies spawn for each Zed+. Higher means rarer. Default 400.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_DayTier1_tooltip: Apocalypse day from which Reinforced Zombies can spawn. They look and sound completely ordinary.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_DayTier3_tooltip: Apocalypse day from which specialised Zed+ can spawn. Before this day, only T1-T2 are rolled.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_DayTier5_tooltip: Earliest day a T4 may evolve into a final form. It must also have survived the delay set below.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_DayTier6_tooltip: Earliest day a T4 may become a Calamity. The zone conditions must be met as well.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_T4SurvivalDays_tooltip: How long a T4 must survive before falling back to a T5 form, once the T5 day has been reached.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_Debug_tooltip: Print Zed+ spawn decisions to the console. Noisy, for testing only.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_AcidSimpleZone_tooltip: Draw a plain circle on top of each acid pool, marking exactly how far it reaches. The splat is still drawn underneath - this adds a clear outline rather than replacing it.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_AcidOverlay_tooltip: Highlight in green every tile an acid pool actually damages, so the damage area can be compared with what is drawn. Needs the game launched with -debug; ignored otherwise.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_PathFast_tooltip: Faster than normal, less resistant. Disabling a path removes it from the roll along with its final forms.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_PathTank_tooltip: Much slower, far tougher. Disabling a path removes it from the roll along with its final forms.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_PathStealth_tooltip: Dulled senses: only notices you from a few tiles away. Disabling a path removes it from the roll along with its final forms.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_PathRanged_tooltip: Keen senses: spots you from far outside normal detection range. Disabling a path removes it from the roll along with its final forms.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormWitch_tooltip: Stands still until disturbed, then screams once and chases you forever.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormVolatile_tooltip: Flies over fences, screams to draw the area in, then dies. Does not attack. Not implemented yet - this switch does nothing.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormColossus_tooltip: Very slow, very tough, barely staggers. Weak to bladed weapons, resistant to blunt.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormBoomer_tooltip: Stops a few tiles away, screams, drops, and bursts into acid. A scorched one is carrying fire as well - and shooting it sets it off.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormSneaker_tooltip: Stands perfectly still while you look at it, and closes the moment you turn away.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormMimic_tooltip: Lies on the ground as a corpse. Wakes if you walk over it or try to loot it.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormSpitter_tooltip: Throws acid pools that corrode equipment and burn uncovered skin.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_FormScout_tooltip: Sprints at you screaming, drawing zombies from as far as a gunshot would.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamitiesEnabled_toolt: Master switch for tier 6. When off, no Calamity ever spawns and the options below are ignored. Not implemented yet - this switch does nothing.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamityHost_tooltip: Immobile and extremely tough. Endlessly spawns Zed+ until it is killed. Not implemented yet - this switch does nothing.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamityMist_tooltip: Fast and fragile. Trails a dense smoke cloud that blinds the area behind it. Not implemented yet - this switch does nothing.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamityLeader_tooltip: Huge and slow. Grabs the zombies around it and hurls them at you. Not implemented yet - this switch does nothing.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamityCentaur_tooltip: Charges at extreme speed, smashing through every breakable obstacle in its path. Not implemented yet - this switch does nothing.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamityRadius_tooltip: Only one Calamity may exist within this radius. Smaller radius means more Calamities on the map.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamityMinZombies_tool: How many zombies must be nearby for a T4 to become a Calamity.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_CalamityPrePlaced_toolt: Place a few Calamities near landmark buildings when the world is created.
Sandbox_SZedPlus_ThrillerEnabled_tooltip: An ultra-rare group of dancing zombies found on roads.
